import os,json,subprocess,pwd,tempfile,shutil,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal')
sha='70458fc1b44102b440d2d4c335b5e54f5279f25c'
stage=root/'.staging'/sha
current=root/'current'
services=['ssh','nginx','postgresql@16-main','pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','fadego-staging','lowcost-europa','pm2-iptvpn-bot','pm2-telegram-robot-leads']
def health():return {x:subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active','--quiet',x],timeout=7).returncode==0 for x in services}
owner_id=stage.stat().st_uid;owner=pwd.getpwuid(owner_id).pw_name
report={'test':'Ferrari staged skill_job real REA MCP tools/list','candidate_sha':sha,'active_before':str(current.resolve()),'services_before':health(),'status':'BLOCKED'}
assert stage.is_dir() and not stage.is_symlink() and (stage/'.git').is_dir()
assert current.is_symlink() and current.resolve().name=='0a1a4c190a7d33752d6dc3f4418ed44735c8a7dd'
assert owner_id!=0 and all(report['services_before'].values())
work=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.canary-rea-',dir=stage))
os.chown(work,owner_id,stage.stat().st_gid)
try:
 request={'version':1,'id':'ferrari-canonical-stage-real-rea-list','kind':'rea-mcp','mcp_requests':[{'method':'tools/list','params':{}}]}
 req=work/'request.json';req.write_text(json.dumps(request));os.chown(req,owner_id,stage.stat().st_gid)
 out=work/'result'
 command=['sudo','-n','-H','-u',owner,'python3','-m','engine.skill_job','--request',str(req),'--output',str(out)]
 x=subprocess.run(command,cwd=stage,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=155)
 report['engine_exit']=x.returncode
 report['produced_response_zip']=(out/'response.zip').is_file()
 if x.returncode!=0 or not report['produced_response_zip']:raise RuntimeError('skill_job-was-not-functional')
 with zipfile.ZipFile(out/'response.zip') as z:
  result=json.loads(z.read('report.json'))
  payload=json.loads(z.read('artifacts/rea-mcp-result.json'))
 report['job_status']=result.get('status')
 report['engine_executor']=payload.get('executor')
 report['response_count']=len(payload.get('responses',[]))
 report['real_tool_list_returned']=any(r.get('method')=='tools/list' and r.get('response') for r in payload.get('responses',[]) if isinstance(r,dict))
 report['canonical_executor']=str(result.get('executor','')).startswith('/srv/projects/skill-universal/.runtime/npm/rea/')
 if report['job_status']!='completed' or not report['real_tool_list_returned'] or not report['canonical_executor']:raise RuntimeError('staged-REA-output-or-path-not-certified')
 report['status']='PASS_REAL_MCP_CANARY_NO_CUTOVER'
except Exception as e:report['error_type']=str(e)[:150]
finally:
 shutil.rmtree(work)
report['temporary_canary_removed']=not work.exists()
report['active_after']=str(current.resolve())
report['services_after']=health()
report['pass']=report['status']=='PASS_REAL_MCP_CANARY_NO_CUTOVER' and report['active_after']==report['active_before'] and report['services_after']==report['services_before'] and report['temporary_canary_removed']
print(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True))
if not report['pass']:raise SystemExit(4)
